item.text: The failure is in whitespace tokenization: both installed package parsers use `strings.Fields`, which discards the empty release token. The filename splitter also assumes every RPM has a dotted architecture suffix, so source names ending in `-src.rpm` are misread. I’m updating parsing to preserve the release position and validating filename components while handling source RPM suffixes explicitly.

The implementation now preserves the empty release slot for installed package lines, applies consistent epoch/version/release formatting to binary and source packages, and recognizes `-src.rpm` filenames including empty releases. I also corrected update candidate epoch handling for `(none)`. The scanner test package is still running through its first build.
